chapter.title: AWS Lambda
chapter.notes: Frequency note (third-party research from _build/spec/FREQUENCY.md; planning input only, never evidence). Lambda and serverless are rank 6 of 42: 4 first-hand reports; strong. Reported sub-topics: limits and memory sizing (also named in the exam guide), triggers, SQS to Lambda, function URLs (one 2023 report), Lambda@Edge (chapter 15), pairing with RDS Proxy (chapter 26). Pairs to decide: Lambda vs Fargate vs ECS on EC2 vs EC2 vs Batch; Step Functions vs SQS vs chained Lambda functions (chapter 32). Stem signals: 'LEAST operational overhead' (managed or serverless), 'unpredictable' or 'spiky' traffic, 'event-driven', 'runs for a few seconds on each upload'. Value that FREQUENCY says changed and that must be checked in the guide before use: the maximum run time of a function. Older material assumes one fixed limit; FREQUENCY reports a longer limit for asynchronous invocations on Lambda Managed Instances, announced in September 2026. That is after the exam eligibility cutoff, so label it not examinable yet. Source note: the guide has a second quotas page for Lambda Managed Instances; the main quotas page is gettingstarted-limits.
